授業概要
う蝕や歯周病の予防法や発症予測または口腔細菌叢を含めた口腔と全身の健康の関係について、研究成果をまとめ、論文を執筆する。論文を投稿後、査読結果をもとにデータの再解析または再実験を行い、論文の受理を目指す。論文執筆までの一連の研究作業を通じて、自ら次の課題を見つけ、柔軟かつ総合的に対応できるような能力を身に付ける。
The students write the research paper about the prevention and predictive method for dental caries and periodontal disease and the association between oral health including oral microbiome and systemic health. After submission of the research paper, the students re-analyze and do re-experiment based on the review comment to accept the research paper. Through the research work, the students acquire the ability to find the problem and flexibly and comprehensively accommodate this problem.
